name: Sanguinary Offering and its Greater form are exclusive on the buffed target (#6448)
contract: Sanguinary Offering is one stamina buff in a single-target rank chain (first spell 706630, ranks 706630-707339, plus Rank 6 707340 which has no spell_ranks row) and a raid-wide Greater form (680299) that grants the same buff. All are spell family 26, effect 0 SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA with aura 29 (MOD_STAT), MiscValue 2 (stamina) and DurationIndex 30, and none carries a stack rule, so a target that receives both the single-target and the raid-wide version holds both auras and their stamina stacks. #6448 reports exactly that at level 60. Expected: one Sanguinary Offering buff per target -- a weaker cast is refused while an equal or stronger offering is present, and an equal or stronger cast replaces the weaker one. Expected before the fix: the second cast stacks (both auras present). Expected after the fix: only the higher offering remains, in both directions.

steps.label: The Greater offering reaches the nearby ally
Wait out the 1.5 s global cooldown (StartRecoveryCategory 133)
The weaker rank is refused while the Greater buff is on the target
The second ally starts with no offering at all
The second ally starts with no plain offering
The plain offering lands on the second ally
The Greater offering replaces the weaker one
The weaker offering is removed: one Sanguinary Offering buff stays
